title: Approve the landing composition
question: The Racing Form is locked. Which composition should we build? What feels false to the world? Approve one, combine, or revise.

options.label: The Card
options.lineage: Daily Racing Form past-performance page with a teller slip
options.thesis: Scan four horses, fill the slip, deposit — the card and the window share one sheet.
options.viewport: Masthead; ranked four-horse grid on the left; BACK THIS HORSE slip on the right; slogan at the foot.
options.risk: Four equal rows can hide which horse is live; the slip can read as a generic sidebar.

options.label: The Call
options.thesis: One horse owns the fold; the rest of the program is a strip you can still pick from.
options.viewport: WARDEN at giant scale with the slip attached; KITE, REDLINE, ASH as a compact program strip.
options.risk: The strip can feel like leftover UI if it is too small to actually choose from.

options.label: The Window
options.thesis: Read the whole card first; the betting window is the next sheet of the same form.
options.viewport: Full-width four-horse table; numbered enter-a-horse margin; BACK THIS HORSE as a full-width teller window below.
options.risk: Deposit falls below the fold on short screens if the table is dense.
